title: AP2 v0.2 mandates, shared types and receipts
caption: Field names from the JSON Schemas in code/sdk/schemas/ap2 at commit e1ea56d (identical to v0.2.0). Closed mandates bind to one checkout; open mandates carry constraints and the agent key. Receipts point back to the closed mandate by hash.
alt: Class diagram. CheckoutMandate has vct mandate.checkout.1, checkout_jwt, checkout_hash, iat and exp. OpenCheckoutMandate has vct mandate.checkout.open.1, constraints, cnf, iat and exp. PaymentMandate has vct mandate.payment.1, transaction_id, payee, pisp, payment_amount, payment_instrument, execution_date, risk_data, iat and exp. OpenPaymentMandate has vct mandate.payment.open.1, constraints, cnf and optional pre-set payee, payment_amount, payment_instrument, pisp, execution_date and risk_data, plus iat and exp. Amount has amount and currency; Merchant has id, name, website; PaymentInstrument has id, type, description; PISP has legal_name, brand_name, domain_name. Closed mandates link to their open parents by sd_hash; the open Payment Mandate links to the open Checkout Mandate by payment.reference; PaymentMandate links to CheckoutMandate because transaction_id equals checkout_hash. PaymentReceipt (status, iss, iat, reference, payment_id) and CheckoutReceipt (status, iss, iat, reference, order_id) reference the closed mandates.
